messages:
maya: quick flag alert — observed duplicate quota attribution when api-proxy coalesces service account claims; same request billed to project+org.
ron: paste minimal trace?
maya: flow: proxy recv X-API-Key=svc-X1 -> auth resolves sa@proj-99/org-7 -> coalesce sets Effective-Identity=sa:svc-X1@proj-99 -> router sets billing.project=proj-99 -> quota increments project:proj-99 AND org:org-7
kevin: root cause: quota service treats X-Orig-* audit headers as attribution even when Effective-Identity exists. precedence bug.
anita: suggest precedence: 1) Effective-Identity header, 2) fallback to X-Orig-* only when missing. add auth_route label coalesced|orig.
ron: telemetry: emit requests.auth.attribution_fallback{reason="orig_used"} and requests.auth.coalesced_count with proxy_version and auth_flow labels.
kevin: rollout: behind feature flag auth_coalesce_v2 + quota_preview_mode (WILL_CHARGE logs, no billing) until 100% ramp.
anita: Console panel mock: "Attribution mismatch rate" + top proxies and top affected projects/orgs; drill to traces.
maya: retention: detailed traces 7d, aggregated metrics 90d.
dev-bot: checklist: auth_coalesce_v2 flag, metrics=[requests.auth.coalesced_count,requests.auth.attribution_fallback], quota_preview_mode.
action items: kevin implement precedence+preview (owner), ron add proxy header toggle and proxy_version label (owner), anita build console mock+playbook (owner), maya run sandbox baseline and report.
maya: will sync tomorrow 10:30 to review sandbox numbers :thumbsup:
